headline.family_guess: serif italic (Georgia/Times-style) for connective words + condensed sans-bold for data labels
headline.case: lowercase for connective ('first,', 'to simply polish the end product.'), Title Case for card labels

caption.family_guess: system sans-serif, small caps on retro terminal card ('CLAUDE CODE') is monospace/pixel font
caption.case: UPPERCASE on retro CRT text, Title Case on data cards

layout.host_pos: top-left small inset at t=0 (webcam-in-browser chrome), then cuts to full-frame host bust shots against warm wood-shelf background at regular intervals
layout.safe_zones: center-vertical column ~70% width holds all cards/icons; top ~10% and bottom ~12% kept clear for platform UI
layout.caption_pos: no burned-in spoken captions visible in sampled frames; on-screen text is graphic/kinetic-typography only, centered

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: 6-9 (fast graphic cuts alternating with 2-4s host holds)
transitions: vertical smear/motion-blur wipe (stacked cards blurring into a vertical streak)

themeable: card content (ad mockups, stat cards, testimonial cards)
icon set (robot mascot, funnel, api/social icons)
host background (wood shelf can swap to any set)
